name: Graphiti MCP Server
summary: Experimental MCP server exposing Graphiti's temporally-aware knowledge graphs (episodes, entities, semantic/hybrid search) to AI assistants.
description: Lives in the `mcp_server/` folder of getzep/graphiti. Uses FalkorDB by default (Neo4j supported); Docker Compose starts FalkorDB and the server with an HTTP endpoint at `http://localhost:8000/mcp/`; stdio is also documented.

agent_access.notes: Self-hosted; HTTP at /mcp/ or stdio. No public hosted endpoint.
